# A struct handed whole to a slot insertion or an event, which is how either
# takes one: their parameter is unnamed, so a spread there names nothing and
# is refused (testdata/error_spread_args.sngl).

sngl test --platform none spread.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

-- spread.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

struct Row {
    title string = ""
}

component table(r Row, cell component(Row)) node {
    vbox {
        cell(r)
    }
}

component slotted node {
    var seen = ""
    table(r=Row{title="hello"}) {
        component cell(row) {
            text(value=row.title)
        }
    }
    button #go(text="go", @click { seen = "clicked" })
}

func testSpreadIntoSlot(t Test, c slotted) {
    c.go.click()
    t.assert(c.seen == "clicked")
}

component emitter(@fired ChangeEvent) node {
    var ev = ChangeEvent{value="v"}
    button #go(text="go", @click { fired(ev) })
}

component listener node {
    var got = ""
    emitter #e(@fired(x) { got = x.value })
}

func testSpreadIntoEmit(t Test, c listener) {
    c.e.go.click()
    t.assert(c.got == "v")
}
